A superficially similar but compatible pair is NOT flagged, and detection reads stop_tree/tool_tree rather than prose (AST).

implementation.method: Walk ALL/ANY/NOT/WEIGHTED/ATOM to extract forced (axis, symbol, polarity) triples. POLARITY = require vs forbid on the same axis+symbol. EXCLUSIVE = two distinct required values on a closed axis (stop.quorum, tool.network). component_trees() reads only stop_tree and tool_tree.

extensions.title: Implement component conflict detection (contradictory stop rules, incompatible tool policy)

negative_controls.description: Planted polarity/exclusive trees must fire; look-alike trees whose prose names unanimity/egress/air-gap must stay silent.
A description-keyword matcher false-positives the look-alike; the tree detector does not. Prose swap leaves structural verdicts.

residual_unknowns.claim: Catalog depends on IMP-0166 and IMP-0175 receipts; those catalog output_path files are absent on this worktree. This unit ships the predicate-tree grammar it consumes (trees.py) rather than reading missing receipts.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Deliver IMP-0166 and IMP-0175 on this worktree, then re-bind detect.py to their live grammar if the on-disk shapes differ.

retry.policy: two strikes then pivot - after the second failure on the same error fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a third attempt

reviewer.notes: Mechanical AST walk of detect.py/trees.py plus a description-only mutant. Catalog named probe2 is the independent tree-not-prose reviewer. This Linux session re-ran both named probes live. Global unit_manifest.py --write was not used.
